name: get_state
description: Current screen as text: HP/gold/energy, enemies with intents, hand with card text, potions, numbered choices, and available actions. Optional include: deck, relics, piles (draw/discard/exhaust contents), map (shown automatically on the map screen).

name: act
description: Run one or more actions in order; returns a line per action describing its effect, then the new state. Actions: play {card: hand number or name, target?: enemy number}; end_turn; choose {choice}; proceed; confirm; skip; cancel; select {drop: [cards]} or {keep: [cards]} (hand-selection screens, auto-confirms); use_potion {slot, target?}; discard_potion {slot}; wait {ms <= 500}. Example: [{"action":"play","card":3,"target":1},{"action":"play","card":"Defend"},{"action":"end_turn"}]

name: get_info
description: Describe cards (with upgraded version), relics, potions, or powers active in combat, by name or ID.

name: get_profile_progress
description: Profile statistics and unlock progress per character, including locked cards and relics. Works from the menu.

name: get_action_status
description: Result of an action reported as still running. Never resend that action.

name: start_game
description: Start a new run from the main menu.

name: continue_game
description: Continue the saved run from the main menu.

name: abandon_run
description: Abandon the saved run from the main menu (counts as a loss; cannot be undone).

name: save_game
description: Return to the main menu. continue_game resumes from the latest autosave (start of the current room).
